price_note: Adjusted closes are today's restated values (split and dividend adjustment as of the store's capture), not the prices printed at the time. The nightly member ledger reads the collector's closes; this history reads the closes file named in inputs. Same functions, two stores; their overlap is recorded in research/breadth_history/OVERLAP_CHECK.md.
redistribution_note: Group-level shares and counts only; no member prices. The Tiingo research reader marks raw views redistribution_admitted=false; member-level history stays off git.
closes_store: Tiingo EOD archive /Volumes/Mastermind/market-data/tiingo (normalized eod-bars, captures 2026-10-11..16) via scripts/build_tiingo_member_closes.py; member-level, off git
missing: 453 dated membership rows have no stored close inside their own membership window and are absent (of these, 144 tickers exist in the store only outside the window, a likely ticker reuse); 425 membership rows carry no sector label and are absent from every sector; labels are as of now, not era-correct (current GICS, current SEC SIC, and the free SIC fill overlay marked sic_derived_fill). Duplicate-series scan: no two member tickers carry the same price series (identical daily returns or a constant price ratio).
duplicate_series_rule: month-by-month hash of daily returns, then pairwise check: >=60 identical returns and >=95% identical between the first and last identical session. Detection and labelling only; no store repaired.
dropped_partial_rows_rule: centred 21-row median of priced names; a row under half is dropped. Looks ahead up to 10 rows to decide which rows are sessions; values themselves use only data on or before their date.
members_counted_note: Sum across sectors of labelled, priced members on the year's last session. Compare with about 500 index members to read the survivorship lean of early years.
not_an_outcome_claim: Data only. No forward return, hit rate or backtest is attached.
